There are 120 seats in B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering.
Candidates need a minimum 50% aggregate (45% for reserved category candidates) in 10+2 for B.Tech admission.

At the time of admission, you need to bring original documents for verification plus two sets of self-attested photocopies of the following: 1. Class 10 marksheet and certificate (as proof of date of birth), 2. Class 12 marksheet, 3. JEE Main, CET, CAT or MAT scorecard (as applicable to the program), 4. Transfer certificate from the last institution attended, 5. Migration certificate (for students from other boards or universities), 6. Aadhaar card as identity proof, 7. Category certificate (reserved category candidates only), 8. Six passport-size photographs, 9. Medical fitness certificate, and 10. Anti-ragging affidavit signed by the student and a parent [S1].
